{{Quote|COMETS-Q! Yessir, it's COMETS-Q that gets you to the battlefield, sustains you once you're there, and gets you home again|[[Mess Boulanger]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Jedi Trial">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref>}}
'''COMETS-Q''' was the mantra of quartermasters who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It stood for "Chemical, Ordnance, Medical, Engineer, Transportation, Signal, and Quartermaster"; the seven things that could make the most difference in a battle.
